Add canonical v1 notification envelope (#132)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-28
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add a producer-neutral `codeoo-notification` workspace crate.
    - Define closed v1 CodeOn and Codeoff producer metadata with typed, bounded authorities.
    - Validate bounded semantic notification content, canonicalize timestamps and JSON bytes, and compute a domain-separated SHA-256 digest.
    - Add exact-byte/digest, replay, bounds, malformed-shape, version, renderer-data, Unicode, and Debug-redaction contract tests.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-notification`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeoo-notification --all-targets -- -D warnings`
    - `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p codeoo-notification --no-deps`
    
    Closes #130
